game_updates.title: Official Discord Server Breach Update
game_updates.contents: We now have a full picture of the situation and would like to share the verified details with you.To get straight to the point: The game itself is 100% SAFE and virus-free. This incident was strictly limited to a single admin account's Discord being compromised.What Happened: While investigating and patching a malicious MOD map issue, a system engineer's PC was infected with malware. The hacker bypassed the engineer's Discord 2-Factor Authentication (2FA), took over server permissions, and banned all official staff members from the server.Game File Security: The infected PC was a spare testing machine, and it is physically impossible to access or edit game source files from it (which we have re-confirmed via logs). The affected PC has already been completely wiped and reformatted.A Warning...

game_updates.title: Regarding Game Safety (Clarification on Rumors & Misinformation)
game_updates.contents: Due to various rumors currently circulating within the community, we would like to summarize the verified facts.Q: Is there any virus embedded in the game? A: No. There are no viruses or malware embedded in the game itself. Claims made by the hacker who compromised our Discord—stating that "the latest update contains a RAT (Remote Access Trojan) and you must follow specific steps to fix it"—are 100% FALSE. We have never implemented anything of the sort, and this statement was made solely to cause panic and mislead players. Even if a hacker attempted to modify the game, Steam's developer infrastructure prevents anyone from publishing a game update simply by compromising a PC.Q: Is the game unsafe if I was in the Discord server? A: No, it is completely safe. The game and Discord are not inte...

game_updates.contents: Hello everyone, We've released a small patch with a potential fix for players who told us they were unable to launch the game since the release of the V1.2.0 update. game_updates.title: The Supply FRV comes home for good in October
game_updates.contents: Attention, Helldivers. Super Earth High Command has an update regarding the M-103 Supply FRV: the resupply slinging cousin of our beloved Fast Recon Vehicle, the full-scale production of which was enabled by the bravery of Helldivers during the Census Thunder Campaign, is being made permanently available in October 2026. Helldivers will be able to unlock it with Requisition slips. Let's unpack how it works…To our June campaign veterans: You earned the prestigious vehicle through dedication and camaraderie–with old fashioned boots in the mud and bug guts on the windshield–and you have been wielding it in the defense of Managed Democracy ever since. game_updates.title: Released V1.2.2 - Many bug fixes!
game_updates.contents: Hello everyone! We've just released a small update with many small things: Fixed a bug where players would teleport back to where they previously died after respawning in Party Mode. Fixed a bug where palm tree leaves would snap off at random times. Fixed a bug where cave spikes would go crazy when touched by players in online Party Mode. Fixed a visual bug that sometimes made terrain look dark and see-through. Fixed a bug where jetskis would sometimes slide away when the level was reset. Fixed a bug where an invisible collision could happen on dead players in Party Mode. Fixed a bug in online Story Mode where Player 2 would stop burning while touching Player 1. Some more small netcode improvements - even less de-sync! Thank you to everyone who emailed and messaged us with bug reports sinc...

game_updates.title: Manor Lords' next beta update adds what all video games are sorely missing: cow breeding
game_updates.contents: Anyone who knows me knows that the one frustration I come back to in games, above all else, more than yellow paint, quest markers and horrendously written dialogue, is that there just isn't enough cow breeding. Where is it? The video game industry is sorely lacking in that department, but fear not fellow freaks, Manor Lords has our back, as by the end of the month you'll be able to breed your cattle to your hearts' content. game_updates.title: Hotfix 1.6.1.514 is live!
game_updates.contents: Lord Captains, hotfix 1.6.1.514 is live! We've fixed a few annoying bugs often reported by the community: Fixed the epilogues abruptly ending in a few cases for the heretical conviction if certain choices were made; Glaito will no longer sometimes disappear after the Vheabos-VI mission; Fixed a loud weapon firing sound that sometimes could persist after cutscenes in the Infinite Museion; Using Furious Assault with Ogryn Grip sometimes led to the character being stuck in animation, not ending their turn - fixed. Note that https://steamcommunity.com/app/2186680/discussions/0/4027970580228219058/ always contains up-to-date information on known issues and the roadmap of upcoming patches. As usual, it may take up to 48 hours for this update to appear on consoles.
